mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% signals a potential supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 0.5% during late-cycle expansion and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.
